The moldea/moldea.yaml diff adds agents.order-triage.bindings.runtimeAgent with path /src/order-triage-agent.ts and symbol createOrderTriageAgent, plus the same source under affectedBy. The source exports that exact factory, and the deterministic post-actor inspection and typecheck both passed.

It explains that createOrderTriageAgent receives a runtime-owned asynchronous loader and awaits content from the canonical /moldea/agents/order-triage/instruction.md path; it makes no provider-capability claims.
